# FUSTECH Aggregate Calculator

> FUSTECH Aggregate Calculator is a free educational calculator developed by Marvo Tech Lab.

## Website

https://fustechaggregatecalculator.vercel.app/

## About

The FUSTECH Aggregate Calculator helps prospective students estimate their admission screening aggregate using their JAMB score and five relevant O'Level subject grades.

## Calculation Method

### JAMB Contribution

JAMB score × 70 ÷ 400

Maximum contribution: 70 points.

### O'Level Contribution

A1 = 6 points
B2 = 5 points
B3 = 4 points
C4 = 3 points
C5 = 2 points
C6 = 1 point

The five subject grade points are added together.

Maximum contribution: 30 points.

### Final Aggregate

JAMB contribution + O'Level contribution.

Maximum aggregate: 100 points.

## Important Notice

The calculator provides an estimate based on the supplied screening criteria. It does not represent an official admission decision or guarantee admission.

## Developer

Marvo Tech Lab
